row.evidence: Drip sells one plan priced by list size ('Pay for your list size. Not for features you never use.'); team members are invited manually under Settings > Account > Members, and no SSO or SCIM appears on the pricing page, help centre or API reference.
row.notes: None by absence: help-centre searches for 'scim' and 'sso' return 0 articles, the pricing page lists no SSO/SCIM, and the REST API only exposes the authenticated user (GET /v2/user) and accounts, with no member-management endpoints. Single plan priced by list size (from $39/mo for 1-2,500 people), not per seat; the price is a monthly figure (no annual toggle shown). Okta OIN and Entra gallery URL guesses for Drip returned 404.

plans.name: Drip
plans.notes: Every feature, including 'Open API access', is included at every list size.

user_api.notes: The Drip REST API manages subscribers, campaigns and workflows; for users it only fetches the authenticated user. Team members cannot be listed, invited or removed via the API.

capabilities.notes: get_user is only the authenticated user; other capabilities absent from the API reference (set false by absence).

endpoints.purpose: List all accounts the token can access

rate_limits.text: 3,600 requests/hour for individual endpoints; 50/hour for batch endpoints.

fallbacks.notes: Members are invited by email under Settings > Account > Members and removed with Revoke.
